fieldValues.title: The language allowlist re-keys wholesale on any upstream edit in a grandfathered field
fieldValues.summary: Entries in scripts/spec-language-allowlist.json are keyed by a digest of keyword plus character offset, so editing one sentence in a field re-fires every grandfathered entry after it in that field. Two content edits in ext:views-l2 and ext:slices produced 42 re-keyed entries whose underlying sites did not change. Filed as srs#626.
evidence: The allowlist site key is a digest of keyword and character index
39 ext:views-l2 and 3 ext:slices keyword-register entries were re-keys of unchanged sites
PR #637 saw the same churn from the other direction: 587 to 588 sites, almost all of it mechanical
fieldValues.body: The churn is not noise to be tolerated: it hides the entries that genuinely changed inside a diff of entries that did not, which is exactly the signal the allowlist exists to give. A content-addressed key would make the file diff meaningfully. srs#626.
